label: prf:volume-from-rigidity
title: Proof of Volume form from rigidity and symplectic self-duality
html: Because \phi is alternating, the pairing B = \mathrm{ev}_V \circ (\mathrm{id} \otimes \phi) satisfies B \circ \tau_{V,V} = -B, where \tau_{V,V} is the symmetry (or braiding) isomorphism. Hence B vanishes on symmetric tensors and factors as B = \epsilon \circ \pi, where \pi \colon V \otimes V \twoheadrightarrow \Lambda^2 V is the canonical projection. Non-degeneracy of \epsilon follows from non-degeneracy of \mathrm{ev}_V (guaranteed by rigidity) and the isomorphism \phi. The duality axioms (\mathrm{ev}_V \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ (\mathrm{id} \otimes \mathrm{coev}_V) = \mathrm{id}_V ensure that \epsilon is preserved by the rigid dualities of \mathbf{C}.
